conditions.label: Has employees
conditions.description: Pays wages or salaries and runs a payroll.

conditions.label: Registered for VAT
conditions.description: Registered for value added tax or a similar turnover tax.

profileFields.label: Company name
profileFields.description: The registered name, including the SARL legal form. The common private limited company under the OHADA company law.

profileFields.label: Numéro RCCM
profileFields.description: The number the company register gave the company.

profileFields.label: Registered office address
profileFields.description: The address on the company register.

profileFields.label: Capital social
profileFields.description: The capital the company was registered with. Leave it empty if the form has no share capital.

roles.label: Director
roles.description: Runs the company and represents it.

roles.label: Shareholder
roles.description: Owns shares or a stake in the company.

setupSteps.title: Choose and check the SARL name
setupSteps.description: Check the name is free in Registre du Commerce et du Crédit Mobilier (RCCM) and follows Comoros's naming rules.
setupSteps.authority: Registre du Commerce et du Crédit Mobilier (RCCM)

setupSteps.title: Prepare the SARL documents
setupSteps.description: Prepare the articles or statutes, the founders' details and the registered office. The registration process sets out what it needs.
setupSteps.authority: Registre du Commerce et du Crédit Mobilier (RCCM)

setupSteps.title: Register the SARL
setupSteps.description: Submit the incorporation documents as Registre du Commerce et du Crédit Mobilier (RCCM) requires. The company exists once the register enters it.
setupSteps.authority: Registre du Commerce et du Crédit Mobilier (RCCM)

setupSteps.title: Register the SARL for tax
setupSteps.description: Register with Ministère des Finances, du Budget et du Secteur Bancaire for the company's tax number and any VAT or payroll accounts it needs.
setupSteps.authority: Ministère des Finances, du Budget et du Secteur Bancaire

setupSteps.title: Register as an employer
setupSteps.description: Before the first hire, register with Ministère des Finances, du Budget et du Secteur Bancaire for payroll and social contributions.
setupSteps.authority: Ministère des Finances, du Budget et du Secteur Bancaire

setupSteps.title: Open a business bank account
setupSteps.description: Banks usually ask for the registration certificate and the tax number.

setupSteps.title: Check licences for your activity
setupSteps.description: Some activities need a permit or a licence from a sector regulator. Check before you start trading.

obligations.title: Annual return or confirmation statement
obligations.description: Check whether an annual return or confirmation statement is due with Registre du Commerce et du Crédit Mobilier (RCCM), then file it and keep the company record current.
obligations.authority: Registre du Commerce et du Crédit Mobilier (RCCM)

obligations.title: Annual financial statements
obligations.description: Prepare the annual accounts. Check whether they must be filed with Registre du Commerce et du Crédit Mobilier (RCCM), the deadline and whether an audit is required.
obligations.authority: Registre du Commerce et du Crédit Mobilier (RCCM)

obligations.title: Corporate income tax return
obligations.description: Check the company's income tax filing with Ministère des Finances, du Budget et du Secteur Bancaire, then file the return and pay by the dates it sets.
obligations.authority: Ministère des Finances, du Budget et du Secteur Bancaire

obligations.title: VAT returns
obligations.description: File VAT returns with Ministère des Finances, du Budget et du Secteur Bancaire and pay any VAT due. Check whether the company is registered and how often it files.
obligations.authority: Ministère des Finances, du Budget et du Secteur Bancaire

obligations.title: Payroll taxes and social contributions
obligations.description: Withhold and remit payroll taxes and social contributions for employees through Ministère des Finances, du Budget et du Secteur Bancaire. Check the rates and dates.
obligations.authority: Ministère des Finances, du Budget et du Secteur Bancaire

obligations.title: Beneficial ownership information
obligations.description: Check whether the country requires a beneficial ownership filing. If it does, keep the record up to date and file it with Registre du Commerce et du Crédit Mobilier (RCCM).
obligations.authority: Registre du Commerce et du Crédit Mobilier (RCCM)

obligations.title: Report changes to the register
obligations.description: Check what changes must be reported to Registre du Commerce et du Crédit Mobilier (RCCM), then tell it about changes to the name, address, directors or share capital within its deadline.
obligations.authority: Registre du Commerce et du Crédit Mobilier (RCCM)

obligations.title: Renew licences and permits
obligations.description: Check which licences your activity needs and renew them before they expire.
